title: Dynamic Shadows fail to Update all possible shadow slots, causing missing (and broken) Shadows
body: ### Tested versions Reproduced in 4.3 stable, 4.4 stable, 4.5 stable, 4.6 stable, 4.6.3 stable ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.5001) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-10105F CPU @ 3.70GHz (8 threads) - 15.87 GiB memory ### Issue description While testing my game, I noticed some lights were not casting shadows at random, which was unexpected because I have 4096 shadow slots, and only under 1 thousand omni lights (each taking 2 slots) After looking in the Shadow Atlas Debug view while running the Game, I noticed that only one of the Quadrants was getting populated. The screen shot was taken after I had briefly seen such an issue, and the other 3 quadrants haven't changed ever during the run Additionally there seem to be occasions where the Lights are rendering from the Wrong Shadow Slot as can be seen in the image below (Left Engine is casting odd Shadows basically nullifying the Light) (How it should look with Shadows) ### Steps to reproduce Observe Shadow Atlas Behavior with tons of Omni Lights, and play around with Quadrant sizes. 4, 16 and even 64 seem to work fine, but beyond (256 and especially 1024) break, even when all quadrants are set to the same values Do note, this only applies to updating lights, and if all of them are static you can see them all fill up over time. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [Light.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28885433/Light.zip)
